subject: Isolation validation: control-plane partition checklist & live diagram session
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridian-corp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for isolation evidence for Private deployment (SOC 2 / SIG)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the earlier demo — our security team at Veridian asked for a short packet describing how Redwood isolates control-plane and data-plane for Private deployments (we're evaluating Dedicated vs Private for our inference workloads). Specifically they want:

- A concise checklist we can use during procurement to validate isolation claims (control-plane partitioning, tenant egress controls, KMS boundaries)
- A high-level network schematic showing how traffic flows between customer VPCs, Redwood control plane, and the management plane for the private deployment
- Any current audit evidence artifacts you can share (index, not raw logs) or a pointer to where evidence lives

Can you provide a one-page checklist and a short walkthrough? Ideally we'd like a 30–45 minute live session next week to walk through the diagram and ask follow-ups.

We need this for our SOC 2 intake on 2026-09-10. Let me know availability.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Security & Compliance
Veridian Corp

Attachments: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for isolation evidence for Private deployment (SOC 2 / SIG)

Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely do this. Quick plan: 

1) I attached a draft "controlplane-partition-checklist-v0.2.pdf" that maps our isolation claims to evidence types (diagram, config extract, audit index). It is a procurement-friendly checklist (one page summary + 2-page appendix).
2) Kimberly will share a proposed schematic for the Private deployment (high level, non-prod artifacts redacted).
3) We can run a live walkthrough and Q&A — I have openings Thursday 2026-09-02 between 09:00–11:30 PT or Friday 2026-09-03 13:00–15:00 PT. Pick one and we'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

High-level notes on the checklist: we call out control-plane isolation (separate control VPC with restricted peering, mutual TLS, KMS per-tenant envelope + HSM-backed KEKs), egress policing (egress ACLs with per-tenant NAT pools), and administrative separation (RBAC + audited sessions). The checklist links to an evidence index rather than bulk logs.

I'll also include a short index CSV with pointers to the evidence artifacts once Kimberly confirms the schematic.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: controlplane-partition-checklist-v0.2.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@veridian-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for isolation evidence for Private deployment (SOC 2 / SIG)

Thanks — adding the schematic draft. A few clarifying bullets below so Lena's team knows what to expect in the live session: 

- Schematic is intentionally high-level (no customer IPs) and highlights three domains: Customer VPCs (tenant workloads), Redwood Private control plane (customer-managed control plane components), and Redwood management plane (ops & telemetry, hosted by Redwood).
- We annotate the control-plane partition: mutual TLS with whitelisted SANs, AWS PrivateLink for ingresses, and a read-only metrics export for customers via a dedicated telemetry VPC.
- Egress controls: per-tenant NAT pools + CIDR whitelisting; we call out where we require explicit contract-level egress allowances for partner integrations.
- Evidence index will contain: config snapshots (redacted), SOC 2 control mappings, CAIQ crosswalk, and a map of relevant logs (audit index) — we'll share pointers only.

Proposed agenda for the 30–45 minute session:
- 5 min: Introductions & goals
- 10 min: Walk the schematic and isolation checklist items
- 15–25 min: Q&A and evidence index walkthrough

I'm dropping the schematic to the shared Drive (see link) and attaching a PNG stub here to speed review.

Kimberly Park
Staff Security Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-isolation-schematic.png, evidence-index.csv

Aditya / Kimberly — this looks great, thank you. Thursday 2026-09-02 09:30 PT works for us (I'll send a calendar invite to confirm). A couple of quick clarifications before the session: 

- Can you confirm whether the KMS envelope keys are customer-managed (BYOK) or Redwood-managed for Private? We may need BYOK for our control objective.
- During the walkthrough please point to the specific artifacts you'll share in the evidence index (we don't need raw logs, but a sample redacted config and the index id will help our audit team).

Procurement — I'll loop you on the meeting invite.

Best,
Lena
Director, Security & Compliance
Veridian Corp
